title: "backstage" of haunted mansion
content: There's a handful of reoccurring locations that I visit that I've never posted about- because I simply cannot find the words to describe. I visited a location last week that I've been to before and I wrote about it in my dream journal... and then I SAW something very reminiscent while starting the Netflix series "Alice in Borderland" last night. My journal entry reads as follows: *I had a snippet from a reoccurring location. Started out with me outside somewhere and I dropped my server book out of my work apron. The book fell out of my pocket & through a storm drain. When I looked down, it appeared to have landed on a ledge about a story down. I made my way into the storm drain area through an open window and it ended up being the "backstage" of this huge haunted mansion I've been to before. The backstage appeared to have inverted staircases that led to each floor.. not the staircases typically used by guests occupying the mansion. This was BACKSTAGE. The place people aren't SUPPOSED to see. The BACK ROOMS. Retreiving my server book seemed to become a worry of the past. I got this overwhelming feeling/reminder that the mansion was very sinister. Opposite from my other haunted mansion dreams where the 'ghosts' are located upstairs, the most haunted floors in this mansion were the lowest. However, I did mention everything was inverted/flipped.. so maybe they were meant to be the top floors. As above, so below. I saw one of the 'ghosts' from a haunted floor passing through the backstage. She saw me too and gave me a subtle acknowledgement, a cocky nod to let me know she saw me.* As stated above, I started watching "Alice in Borderland" last night. I watched 2 episodes. Not sure which episode showed the indoor staircase of the warehouse that they're in... but god damn... I got the most intense chills all over my body. Very similar to what I saw in the dream. Most staircases in modern buildings are in their own corridors; the staircase in the series, similar to my dream, were exposed. Also notably, in the dream the inverted staircase reminded me of a green house. There was ivy wrapping around the metal stair fixtures, planters with greenery on ledges etc. There were weeds, things were overgrown & all plants looked as if they've been unattended. The stairs looked similar to an outside fire escape where they could collapse and bend. It was bright, day-time during my dream. I know I've been here several times.
